analysis: Documentation-only changes. docs/developer/serving-performance-qualification.md adds a head-side paragraph (lines 18-25) clarifying that automatic startup calibration (ModelCalibrationPolicy.startup, EngineMeasurementPurpose.startupWarmup) is separate from profile qualification: it only refreshes ordinary rate estimates and does not qualify a timing envelope, raise concurrency or lower memory reserves. This keeps the existing qualification gates intact and does not weaken any security boundary. docs/developer/test.md (patch lines 41-96 region) adds test descriptions for MiMo FP32 preflight-refusal fixtures and startup performance recovery/calibration suites, with env gates such as MIMO_V26_SERIAL_NATIVE_TESTS. No source code, auth, attestation, encryption, cache storage or billing behavior changes. T-041 (prefix cache) and TB-011 are not touched. The empty-patch unit 67373c0eff1153bd:0 is metadata only (mode 100644 unchanged). No new attack surface or threat-model invalidation was found. The next pass should check whether the actual startup calibration code, which is not in this PR, has any security impact such as timing oracles from calibration or customer-work preemption.
